arguments.sql:
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.rowid AS row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        n.pizza_name,
        o.order_time,
        CASE WHEN n.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id,
        o.exclusions,
        o.extras
    FROM main.pizza_clean_customer_orders AS o
    JOIN main.pizza_names AS n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
),
topping_occurrences AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, standard.value AS topping_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN main.pizza_recipes AS r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || r.toppings || ']') AS standard
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.exclusions, '') || ']') AS excluded
        WHERE excluded.value = standard.value
    )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.row_id, extra.value AS topping_id
    FROM orders AS o
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.extras, '') || ']') AS extra
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT occurrence.row_id, t.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
    FROM topping_occurrences AS occurrence
    JOIN main.pizza_toppings AS t ON t.topping_id = occurrence.topping_id
    GROUP BY occurrence.row_id, t.topping_name
)
SELECT
    o.row_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.pizza_name,
    o.pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE(
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            CASE WHEN t.quantity > 1 THEN '2x ' ELSE '' END || t.topping_name,
            ', ' ORDER BY (t.quantity > 1) DESC, t.topping_name
        ),
        ''
    ) AS ingredients
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN topping_counts AS t ON t.row_id = o.row_id
GROUP BY o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_name, o.order_time
ORDER BY o.row_id ASC
LIMIT -1
